instruction: Make network-dependent behavior deterministic and race-free
relevant_when: Tests verify API calls, depend on live backend data, or cover error and edge states
context: A response wait must be registered before the action that triggers the request. States that cannot be forced on live data (server errors, out-of-stock, restricted regions) should be reproduced with route.fulfill or recorded HAR rather than left untested or skipped. route.abort() for blocking trackers is hygiene, not mocking.

checklist.name: wait-before-action
checklist.rule: page.waitForResponse/waitForRequest is started before the click or navigation that triggers it (promise created first, awaited after, or Promise.all)
checklist.relevant_when: A test verifies that an API call happened

checklist.name: edge-states-mocked
checklist.rule: Error and edge states that cannot be produced reliably on live data are covered with route.fulfill or HAR replay, not skipped or left untested
checklist.relevant_when: A scenario depends on a server error, empty state or restricted condition

checklist.name: explicit-fulfill-fields
checklist.rule: route.fulfill sets status, contentType and body explicitly

checklist.name: route-patterns-environment-agnostic
checklist.rule: Route patterns use globs or regexes that work across environments rather than full hardcoded hostnames

checklist.name: third-party-isolated
checklist.rule: Third-party scripts (analytics, chat, ads) are blocked or stubbed so they cannot affect test timing
